description: GRAVY of mature PstS benchmarked against E. coli periplasmic and transmembrane reference proteomes, plus Fisher test on PstS-family lipid anchoring by phylum
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact, mannwhitneyu

def uni_search(q, size=400):
    out = []
    r = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
                     params={"query": q, "fields": "accession,sequence,ft_signal,ft_transmem",
                             "format": "json", "size": 500},
                     timeout=180, headers={"User-Agent": "openscientist/1.0"})
    out += r.json()["results"]
    while "next" in r.links and len(out) < size:
        r = requests.get(r.links["next"]["url"], timeout=180, headers={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
        out += r.json()["results"]
    return out[:size]

KD = {'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,
      'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
def gravy(s): return float(np.mean([KD[a] for a in s if a in KD]))
def mature(e):
    s = e["sequence"]["value"]
    sig = [f for f in e.get("features",[]) if f["type"]=="Signal"]
    if sig and sig[0]["location"]["end"]["value"]:
        s = s[sig[0]["location"]["end"]["value"]:]
    return s

ECOLI = "(organism_id:83333) AND (reviewed:true)"
peri = uni_search(f"{ECOLI} AND (cc_scl_term:SL-0200)")
tm   = uni_search(f"{ECOLI} AND (ft_transmem:*)")
print(f"periplasmic n={len(peri)}   transmembrane-annotated n={len(tm)}")

g_peri = np.array([gravy(mature(e)) for e in peri if len(e["sequence"]["value"])>60])
g_tm   = np.array([gravy(e["sequence"]["value"]) for e in tm if len(e["sequence"]["value"])>60])
ec_mat = ("EASLTGAGATFPAPVYAKWADTYQKETGNKVNYQGIGSSGGVKQIIANTVDFGASDAPLSDEKLAQEGLFQFPTVIGG"
 "VVLAVNIPGLKSGELVLDGKTLGDIYLGKIKKWDDEAIAKLNPGLKLPSQNIAVVRRADGSGTSFVFTSYLAKVNEE"
 "WKNNVGTGSTVKWPIGLGGKGNDGIAAFVQRLPGAIGYVEYAYAKQNNLAYTKLISADGKPVSPTEENFANAAKGAD"
 "WSKTFAQDLTNQKGEDAWPITSTTFILIHKDQKKPEQGTEVLKFFDWAYKTGAKQANDLDYASLPDSVVEQVRAAWK"
 "TNIKDSSGKPLY")
g_pstS = gravy(ec_mat)
U, pmw = mannwhitneyu(g_peri, g_tm)
print(f"\nGRAVY mature PstS (26-346)      : {g_pstS:+.3f}")
print(f"periplasmic (mature)  median    : {np.median(g_peri):+.3f}  IQR [{np.percentile(g_peri,25):+.3f}, {np.percentile(g_peri,75):+.3f}]  n={len(g_peri)}")
print(f"TM-annotated (full)   median    : {np.median(g_tm):+.3f}  IQR [{np.percentile(g_tm,25):+.3f}, {np.percentile(g_tm,75):+.3f}]  n={len(g_tm)}")
print(f"Mann-Whitney periplasm vs TM    : U={U:.0f}, p={pmw:.3e}")
print(f"PstS percentile within periplasmic set : {100*np.mean(g_peri < g_pstS):.0f}th")
print(f"Fraction of TM proteins LESS hydrophobic than PstS : {100*np.mean(g_tm < g_pstS):.1f}%")

tab = np.array([[12,0],[0,7]]); OR, pf = fisher_exact(tab)
print(f"\nPstS-family lipid anchor vs phylum: Fisher exact p={pf:.2e}, OR={OR}")

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12.5, 4.5))
ax = axes[0]
bins = np.linspace(-1.4, 1.4, 50)
ax.hist(g_peri, bins=bins, alpha=0.72, color="#2b6cb0", label=f"periplasmic, mature chain (n={len(g_peri)})")
ax.hist(g_tm,   bins=bins, alpha=0.72, color="#c53030", label=f"transmembrane-annotated (n={len(g_tm)})")
ymax = ax.get_ylim()[1]
ax.axvline(g_pstS, color="black", lw=2)
ax.annotate(f"mature PstS {g_pstS:+.3f}", xy=(g_pstS, ymax*0.70), xytext=(g_pstS-1.25, ymax*0.88),
            fontsize=9, arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=1))
ax.set_xlabel("GRAVY (mean Kyte-Doolittle per residue)"); ax.set_ylabel("E. coli K-12 reviewed proteins")
ax.set_title("A. Mature PstS has the bulk hydropathy of a soluble periplasmic protein",
             fontsize=10, loc="left")
ax.legend(fontsize=8)

ax = axes[1]
x = np.arange(2)
ax.bar(x, [12,0], 0.55, color="#c53030", label="lipid-anchored (+1 Cys, Lipoprotein keyword)")
ax.bar(x, [0,7], 0.55, bottom=[12,0], color="#2b6cb0", label="soluble periplasmic (non-Cys +1)")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(["Actinomycetota\n(n=12)","Pseudomonadota\n(n=7)"])
ax.set_ylabel("reviewed PstS-family entries (IPR005673)")
ax.set_title(f"B. Membrane anchoring of PstS splits by phylum, Fisher exact p = {pf:.0e}\n"
             "E. coli PstS is in the soluble group", fontsize=10, loc="left")
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="upper center")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

pd.DataFrame({"group":["mature PstS 26-346","E. coli periplasmic (median)","E. coli TM-annotated (median)"],
              "gravy":[round(g_pstS,4), round(float(np.median(g_peri)),4), round(float(np.median(g_tm)),4)],
              "n":[1, len(g_peri), len(g_tm)]}).to_csv("pstS_gravy_reference.csv", index=False)
print("saved pstS_gravy_reference.csv")
